subject: English
stimulus: (a) This is Bangladesh ⎯⎯. (b) The people of Bangladesh are friendly though ⎯⎯. (c) When anyone falls in danger, others ⎯⎯. (d) We love and help one another as if ⎯⎯. (e) We work seriously lest ⎯⎯.
guide_solution: (a) This is Bangladesh which is our motherland. (b) The people of Bangladesh are friendly though they are not wealthy. (c) When anyone falls in danger, others come forward to help him immediately. (d) We love and help one another as if we were members of a family. (e) We work seriously lest we should fail to prosper day by day.
